faqs.question: Do I need to buy a separate inverter?
faqs.answer: No. Battery, inverter, and protection are integrated and pre-wired in one cabinet. You connect PV, grid, and the load panel.

faqs.question: How is it different from buying separate components?
faqs.answer: An all-in-one is pre-integrated, pre-tested, and covered by one warranty. Separate components give more freedom in sizing and brand, but need system design and more installation work.

faqs.question: How do I choose the capacity?
faqs.answer: Send daily kWh, peak load, backup hours, and PV size. Those four set the model and the runtime estimate.
